text:
Lina Park: Quick UX bug hunt on the routing policy editor: when preview-sim is open and you scrub the timeline, insertion guides flicker and priority markers jump. Feels like two competing render passes.
Marco Li: Repro'd. Timeline scrub triggers a full sim re-run which reorders the preview tokens mid-drag. Suggest debouncing sim updates while a drag or scrub is active and add a 'preview frozen' badge.
Evan (a11y): Also noticed that insertion guides have no aria-describedby; screen reader users don't get context when a guide becomes visible. Recommend aria-describedby pointing to a hidden live region: `div#rp-live[aria-live=polite]`. Update text with: "Insert at position 2 between Allowlist and Rate Limit".
Ruth: Microcopy idea: change the inline hint from "Drop to reorder" to "Insert at position X — press Enter to confirm" when keyboard mode is on. Keeps it actionable.
Lina Park: Good. Also in compact density the priority pill overlaps the drag handle; suggest moving pill to the left edge of the card during drag and keeping handle visible.
Marco Li: Dev constraints: virtual list virtualization reuses DOM nodes; need stable virtual-key mapping to avoid visual jumps. We'll assign a stable clientKey on mount and use it for animation mapping.
Evan (a11y): Keyboard flow: when user enters move mode announce: "Move mode: use arrow keys to place rule. Press Enter to insert or Escape to cancel." On each arrow move announce the new context via the live region. Throttle updates to 150ms to avoid spamming.
prod-bot: Note: design sync Wednesday 11am PT. Agenda: frozen-preview badge, aria live strings, compact-mode alignment, timeline debounce. Please drop short gifs before noon. :calendar:
